description: Conflict analysis for external-e2e-activity-lifecycle-validation against other validation specifications

conflicts.description: External E2E validation DEPENDS ON lifecycle logging to verify phase 3 (log analysis). Lifecycle logging provides the events that external validation checks for.
conflicts.resolution: No action required - specifications work together
conflicts.recommendation: External E2E validation should reference lifecycle logging patterns when analyzing logs in phase 3

conflicts.description: Both validate activity execution but at different levels: External E2E uses black-box testing (compiled binary + DB queries), Clean Environment validates internal code structure (agent configs, MCP flows). No conflicts - they validate different aspects.
sharedComponents: Template storage/retrieval (external E2E checks DB, Clean Env checks MCP flow)
conflicts.resolution: No action required - complementary validation strategies
conflicts.recommendation: Both validations should pass for complete confidence in activity system

conflicts.relationship: Dependency - external E2E depends on MCP flow
conflicts.description: External E2E validation expects templates to be stored in SurrealDB via MCP backend. If MCP-only flow is broken, external E2E phase 1 (template storage verification) will fail.
sharedComponents: Template storage: TemplateRepository → MCP backend → SurrealDB
conflicts.resolution: External E2E validation should run AFTER MCP-only flow validation passes
conflicts.recommendation: Add prerequisite check in external E2E harness: verify MCP-only flow validation passed before running

conflicts.relationship: Sequential - external E2E provides data for learning loop
conflicts.description: External E2E validation executes templates and creates execution records in DB. Learning loop E2E validation consumes these execution records to verify learning metrics. External E2E should run first to populate test data.
conflicts.resolution: Run external E2E before learning loop E2E to ensure execution data exists
conflicts.recommendation: Document validation order in test suite: external E2E → learning loop E2E
